messages:
alyssa: Quick sync — HealthCo POC request: they want SOC 2 Type II PDF, ISO 27001 excerpts, and a pen-test attestation letter for procurement. Can we share these for a POC? Need list of exact artifacts and any blockers. deadline: EOW.

mike: We can provide the SOC2 PDF (redacted) and the ISO excerpts. Pen-test: we have a vendor-attested letter template. Do they need raw findings or just the attestation? Also: will they need staging IPs / network diagram for scan?

sarah: We should not share raw vulnerability findings. Standard approach: redacted SOC2 report, SoA excerpt, and a vendor-signed pen-test attestation letter. For HIPAA-specific controls (they mentioned PHI in the RFP), we need a signed BAA before exchanging more detailed artifacts. Otherwise provide controls summary only.

jack: FYI dedicated/pinned staging for their POC (isolated tenant, KMS separation) will bump pricing — if they insist on an on-prem-like environment for scan or full e2e test, include that in the quote. If they accept redacted artifacts + presigned bundle we can keep POC within normal credits.

alyssa: healthco says they will sign a BAA but need the artifacts to finish the procurement by Friday. Is presigned S3 share + redacted PDF acceptable from security/legal perspective?

legal-bot: Heads-up: before sharing any SOC2 report we need a signed MSA/assurance NDA or BAA depending on PHI. If they sign the BAA, legal will route the pen-test attestation for signature.

mike: Plan: prepare a proofpack ZIP containing: soc2_redacted.pdf, iso_excerpts.pdf, pen_test_attestation.pdf, network_diagram_highlevel.pdf, encryption_kms_summary.txt. I can put it on a presigned link valid 7 days. Example command I’ll use:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/healthco-poc-1717778889.zip --expires-in 604800
```

sarah: That bundling works. Make sure we remove any ticket IDs / internal IPs from network diagram, redact usernames, and strip exact timestamps from logs. Add a short README explaining what is redacted and why.

alyssa: Great. I'll chase procurement for BAA signature now. If they sign by tomorrow morning, can we target delivery by EOD tomorrow? :crossed_fingers:

jack: If they request dedicated staging (ephemeral L2 isolation) for pen-test, confirm with finance — likely add-on. Otherwise presigned proofpack is standard.

mike: Sounds good. I'll start assembling artifacts and mark redaction checklist. Will ping here with presigned URL once legal confirms we can send.

alyssa: Thanks everyone — tagging @healthco-ops contact. will update once BAA is in. :thumbsup:
